student.interest: M2 INT items (likert5, best_worst, forced_choice) by key.cluster
student.passion: M2 PAS FLOW and INTRINSIC by key.cluster plus open_text
student.aptitude: M4 percentiles weighted by clusters.json apt
student.confidence: M7 SE and SE_CAREER by key.cluster
student.values: M5 value ranks via clusters.json values

parent.observed: M8 batch 1: EARLY_BEHAVIOUR, CURRENT_BEHAVIOUR (key.cluster_hint), MULTIPLE_INTELLIGENCE (via intelligence_to_clusters), TEACHER_FEEDBACK (key.cluster_hint)
parent.preference: M8 EXPECTATION PARENT_PREF, PARENT_PRIDE, PARENT_RESIST; M1 parent_pref (student's view of parent)

ATTENTION: refer to school counsellor or doctor if persistent; never label
